sections.Profile:
The "Iron Maiden" pinball machine, released in January 1982 by Stern Electronics, is the last multi-level game produced by Classic Stern. It features four flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball. With a sci-fi fantasy theme, this wide-body machine showcases digital displays and was produced in a limited run of 1,200 units.
